purpose: Qualify recipient acknowledgement, local action, outcome maturity and minimised response feedback separately from the source fraud assertion.

source_register.title: LEX-NET-028 typed receipt algebra and anti-receipt-laundering contract
supports: Receipt classes must not be upgraded to stronger meanings without the required evidence and authority
does_not_support: A recipient response is proof of fraud or legal liability

source_register.title: South African payment fraud signal contract v1
supports: Signal identity, issuer/purpose scope, correction lifecycle and advisory-only action boundary
does_not_support: A recipient action receipt is independent adjudicated truth

source_register.authority: BIS CPMI / Payments and Market Infrastructures
source_register.title: Enhancing cross-border payments: fast payment system interlinking and fraud controls
supports: Cross-participant coordination, privacy and victim safeguards are material to payment fraud response
does_not_support: A Mycelix recipient feedback API or a common South African liability rule

source_register.title: Combating illicit financial flows linked to scam compounds
supports: Rapid cross-sector response, victim-centred safeguards and accountable information sharing are important
does_not_support: A universal 24-72 hour SLA for all South African payment participants

profiles.notes: Synthetic recipient profile only. The local institution retains authority for every local action; shared response feedback is not a fraud adjudication or a customer-level liability determination.
